d: In this video, Firstpost explains how a powerful Thanksgiving 2026 storm is threatening millions of Americans with widespread power outages, flash floods, coastal flooding and severe travel disruptions. With wind gusts reaching 60 mph, more than 20 states could face dangerous weather conditions from Florida to Maine. The storm could also disrupt the iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, forcing giant balloons to be grounded. Heavy rainfall, damaging winds, Midwest snow and airport delays are raising concerns during America’s busiest holiday travel period. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the…
